goal: Close the hole lint_wiki.py:443 names: Mermaid blocks ship to main unparsed, so a syntax error surfaces as a red error box on the live site with only a human PR preview between it and the reader. A Node checker parses every block with the same mermaid version the browser loads (11.17.2, pinned in site/build.py and asserted by the checker), using mermaid.parse + jsdom instead of mermaid-cli's Chromium. Syntax only — overlapping labels and unreadable layout stay a human job. Design: plan.md.

tasks.title: scripts/check_mermaid.mjs — parse every Mermaid block against the pinned version
tasks.acceptance: `node scripts/check_mermaid.mjs <dir>` walks the wiki tree, extracts every ```mermaid fence, and calls mermaid.parse on each. Exit 0 with a per-block OK count when all parse; exit 1 naming `<page>:<line>` and the parser message when any fails. It reads MERMAID_VERSION out of site/build.py and exits 2 if the installed mermaid package version differs. Demonstrated three ways: (a) the 17 real blocks from feat/wiki-illustrate all parse, (b) a copy of one of them with a deliberately broken arrow exits 1 and names that file, (c) a corpus with no diagrams exits 0 with an explicit "no diagrams" line, and (d) a mismatched MERMAID_VERSION pin exits 2 naming both versions.

tasks.title: Wire the checker into the verify job and ignore root node_modules
tasks.acceptance: verify.yml's `verify` job installs mermaid and jsdom with `npm i --no-save` at pinned versions and runs `node scripts/check_mermaid.mjs`, after the existing build/audit steps. `.gitignore` carries `node_modules/` and `git check-ignore node_modules` reports it ignored. The `lint` job is unchanged and still needs no Node; deploy.yml is untouched.

tasks.title: Record the gate: §2.3 row, §2.4 rule, docs/index.md, log line
tasks.acceptance: §2.3's verification table gains a row for the checker with its install command and pass condition. §2.4 gains one rule covering what the check does and does not prove, why mermaid-cli was rejected, and the version-pin assertion. docs/index.md lists tasks/phase-19-mermaid-render-check/. docs/log.md gains exactly one `site` line at close-out. lint_wiki.py exits 0 afterwards.

tasks.title: Open the PR and watch the new step's first run go green
tasks.acceptance: PR opened against main. `gh run list` shows the verify workflow's run for this PR succeeding, and the new step's log shows the version assertion passing and the block count for main's corpus. Per §2.4 (2026-07-17) the phase stays open until that run is observed green — never assumed.
